items.pt:
As a developer and job seeker, I experienced the universal frustration of modern resume builders:
You spend 45 minutes formatting your projects, tuning your experience, and tweaking your skills. Then you click "Download PDF", and BAM:


"Start your 14-day trial for $2.99 (auto-renews at $29.99/mo)" or you get an ugly watermark slapped across the middle of your resume.
I decided to solve this once and for all by building ZenResume.

items.pt: We study the problem of navigating cluttered indoor environments with a humanoid robot. Unlike conventional methods that model navigation as a 2D path planning problem, humanoid traversal in cluttered environments requires continuous geometry-aware whole-body adaptation, including coordinated arm placement, torso adjustment, and gait modulation for collision-free movement through complex 3D spaces. items.pt: World models are increasingly used as policy-in-the-loop imagination environments, where reliable rollouts require fine-grained controllability with respect to low-level robot actions. items.title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
items.pt: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that plan over long horizons and act through external tools. items.title: NOAH: Learning the Full Patient Journey. A Longitudinal Multimodal Time-Aware Model for Representation and Forecasting
